name: Silver Whetstone
lore: Smith's advice: tell the stone what you want. Silver grit listens, once.

name: Might Whetstone
lore: Quarry grit, coarse as a curse. Takes the polish off and leaves the bite.

name: Crit Whetstone
lore: 'How fine a grit?' 'Fine enough to find the gap between two rivets.'

name: Hit Whetstone
lore: Old Brannoc says a crooked blade is just a club with opinions. Use this.

name: Weight Whetstone
lore: Takes off the metal every smith swears he needs.
